queries:
SELECT fundflux,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry)) OVER () AS ratio_to_total,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry)) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN scanqc q ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
GROUP BY p.fundflux;
SELECT CASE WHEN fundflux IS NULL OR TRIM(fundflux) = '' THEN NULL ELSE fundflux END AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS project_count
FROM projects
GROUP BY CASE WHEN fundflux IS NULL OR TRIM(fundflux) = '' THEN NULL ELSE fundflux END;
SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS project_count FROM projects GROUP BY fundflux;
SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT q.arcref) AS project_count
FROM scanqc q
JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
GROUP BY p.fundflux
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Total', SUM(cnt)
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.arcref) AS cnt
  FROM scanqc q
  JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.arcref) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects) AS fraction
FROM scanqc q;
